```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
# One position per player-season (a handful of ids repeat).
roster_pos <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position
   FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
leaves <- population_leaves(outcomes, roster_pos)
leaf_fill <- leaf_palette()
leaf_fill <- leaf_fill[names(leaf_fill) %in% levels(droplevels(leaves$leaf))]
seasons <- sort(unique(leaves$final_season))
all_x <- max(seasons) + 3
# The data's first seasons hold players whose earlier seasons it never saw,
# so few of them could reach an eligible season in it.
early <- leaves |>
  summarise(
    set_aside = mean(leaf %in% c("Never draft-eligible", "Ruled out")),
    .by = "final_season"
  ) |>
  arrange(final_season) |>
  filter(cumall(set_aside > 0.9)) |>
  pull(final_season)
# Seasons in which the data adds a quarter or more players over the season
# before: new programs and deeper rosters bring many one-season players.
coverage_jumps <- roster_pos |>
  count(season) |>
  arrange(season) |>
  filter(n / lag(n) >= 1.25) |>
  pull(season)
current <- max(seasons)

# Share of each leaf in each final season, plus one bar for every season.
leaf_shares <- function(d, by = NULL) {
  bind_rows(
    count(d, across(all_of(by)), final_season, leaf),
    count(d, across(all_of(by)), leaf) |> mutate(final_season = NA_integer_)
  ) |>
    mutate(
      share = n / sum(n),
      total = sum(n),
      .by = all_of(c(by, "final_season"))
    ) |>
    mutate(
      x = coalesce(final_season, all_x),
      when = if_else(
        is.na(final_season),
        "All seasons",
        paste("Final college season", final_season)
      )
    )
}
leaf_bars <- function(d) {
  # Only the two palest leaves are outlined: an outline on every segment
  # would hide the thin draft-round slivers. group = leaf keeps the stack in
  # palette order (the tooltip would otherwise set the groups).
  ggplot(d, aes(x, 100 * share, fill = leaf)) +
    geom_col_interactive(
      aes(
        tooltip = tooltip,
        data_id = leaf,
        group = leaf,
        colour = leaf %in% c("Still playing", "Position not recorded")
      ),
      width = 0.85,
      linewidth = 0.3,
      position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(`TRUE` = "#9CA3AF", `FALSE` = NA),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = leaf_fill,
      breaks = names(leaf_fill),
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(seq(min(seasons), max(seasons), by = 4), all_x),
      labels = c(seq(min(seasons), max(seasons), by = 4), "All"),
      expand = expansion(add = 0.6)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = \(y) paste0(y, "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(
        ncol = 1,
        reverse = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(colour = "#9CA3AF")
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
overall <- leaf_shares(leaves) |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s: %s players, %s of the %s",
      when,
      tolower(leaf),
      fmt(n),
      pct(share),
      fmt(total)
    )
  )
drafted_all <- sum(overall$share[
  is.na(overall$final_season) & grepl("^Drafted", overall$leaf)
])

p <- leaf_bars(overall) +
  labs(
    title = "Every college roster player, by how the path ended",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "By final college season; ",
      pct(drafted_all),
      " were drafted, darker green for an earlier round"
    ),
    x = "Final college season",
    y = "Players",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Final season ",
      paste(early, collapse = " or "),
      ": too few seasons in the data to become eligible.\n",
      current,
      ", under way: never draft-eligible here is mostly not eligible yet.\n",
      and_join(coverage_jumps),
      ": a quarter or more players in the data than the season before.\n",
      card_caption(release)
    )
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.6)),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm")
  )

card_thumbnail(
  p,
  "roster-player-leaves-by-season",
  release = release,
  height = 6.5
)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-path
# One panel per path, drafted rounds together; each bar splits that path's
# players in that final season by position group.
# The position-not-recorded path is that one group by definition, so it gets
# no panel.
path_levels <- unique(sub("Drafted, round [0-9]", "Drafted", names(leaf_fill)))
path_levels <- setdiff(path_levels, "Position not recorded")
n_no_pos <- sum(leaves$leaf == "Position not recorded")
group_fill <- c(position_palette(), "Position not recorded" = "#E5E7EB")
paths <- leaves |>
  filter(leaf != "Position not recorded") |>
  mutate(
    path = factor(sub("Drafted, round [0-9]", "Drafted", leaf), path_levels)
  )
by_path <- bind_rows(
  mutate(paths, x = final_season),
  mutate(paths, x = all_x)
) |>
  count(path, x, group) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), total = sum(n), .by = c("path", "x")) |>
  mutate(
    when = if_else(x == all_x, "All seasons", paste("Final college season", x)),
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s: %s %s players, %s of the %s",
      path,
      when,
      fmt(n),
      tolower(group),
      pct(share),
      fmt(total)
    )
  )
p_path <- ggplot(by_path, aes(x, 100 * share, fill = group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = group, group = group),
    width = 0.85,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~path, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_fill, breaks = names(group_fill)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(seq(min(seasons), max(seasons), by = 4), all_x),
    labels = c(seq(min(seasons), max(seasons), by = 4), "All"),
    expand = expansion(add = 0.6)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = \(y) paste0(y, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(
    title = "Who takes each path, by position group",
    subtitle = "Each bar splits one path's players in a final college season by position group",
    x = "Final college season",
    y = "Players on the path",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Eligible players are grouped by their first eligible season's position, the rest by their final season's.\n",
      "The ",
      fmt(n_no_pos),
      " eligible players with no recorded position have no panel. A path with no players in a season has no bar."
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
card_interactive(p_path, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 14)
```
